failure_modes: Using the idea to excuse avoidance
gloss: Act from flow and least resistance rather than from a goal or need to prove
invariants: Action does not depend on proving worth
mechanism: Following the Taoist idea of wu-wei, action arises without deliberate attachment, as a bird chirps. The same decision made from creation instead of from insecurity or trauma aligns thought, action, and circumstance into one line. A companion built on it aims at flow instead of commanding a schedule.
